svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a block 16 long x 32 wide x 24 tall from 16 mm HDPE.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore a 31 mm half-round seat across the top, its centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 28 mm above the deck (60 mm above the table).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 4.2 mm hole 10 mm up the middle from below for a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 mm self-tapping screw put up through the deck.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 3 mm pilot holes in the sides for the band clip ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the arrestor lies in the seat, centred on the gas line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the band clip wraps over it into the side holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the arrestor sits level with the drier outlet.
